name: Abhilash Chaturvedi
tagline: MEng Mechanical Engineer. Simulation, automation and design.
intro: I am a First Class MEng Mechanical Engineering graduate from the University of Southampton. I spent a year at Siemens DISW testing and automating a CFD and FEA simulation platform, and my degree projects covered combustion CFD, aerodynamics, thermal design and digital twins. This site collects that work and the new projects I am building to widen my skills.
